name: Misaki
source:
A runaway girl taken in by the main character, Ichito.
She stubbornly hides her surname.

A beautiful, pure and innocent girl with translucent white skin.
She has the presence of a rich lady.
The story is set in Okinawa, where the sunlight is strong, so she often uses a parasol, which suits her well.

Contrary to her appearance, she has a little devilish personality.
She has a straightforward nature, and is quick to act on her ideas.
To put it in a good way, she is positive, but to put it in a bad way, she is reckless and likes to play pranks.
Perhaps because she is a rich lady, she is fearless, which can make her even more devious.
